item.title: Red Sox Face Tough Choice On Jarren Duran’s $11.1 Million Contract
item.description: Jamie LeBlanc-Imagn Images The Boston Red Sox face a difficult decision regarding Jarren Duran as the offseason approaches. The team must determine if he is worth a projected salary of $11.1 million for the 2027 season. His performance dropped significantly in 2026, creating a complex situation for the front office. Talk Sox reported that his value has never been lower while the fan base wants him gone. This financial commitment could block other necessary moves to improve the lineup. Duran’s 2026 campaign was a frustrating mix of power and poor contact rates. NESN noted that this decline made it hard for him to provide the impact Boston expected. The team now weighs his speed and power against a high cost and a lack of consistency. The clock is ticking on the non-tender deadline, and the organization must act fast. From All-Star Highs to 2026 Lows Jarren Duran has had a career defined by extreme ups and downs since his debut. He showed flashes of greatness during his breakout 2024 season when he earned All-Star honors and All-Star MVP honors for his home run. Talk Sox highlighted that he accumulated 9.0 WAR that year with 48 doubles and 14 triples. That performance cemented his place in the lineup and made him a fan favorite for a time. The situation changed drastically after that peak performance. His 2025 season saw a slight step back, but 2026 brought a steep decline in offensive production. According to NESN, his .207 batting average and .627 OPS represented a major decline compared to prior seasons. He struck out 165 times, which hurt his ability to use his speed effectively on the base paths. This regression has raised serious questions about his future role with the team. Before the 2026 season, Duran had already faced significant mental health challenges due to early career on-field struggles. The pressure of his early struggles and the 2022 incident where he lost a ball in the lights had a serious impact on him. Despite rebounding to post a 2.2 WAR in 2023, the 2026 performance suggests his struggles are far from over. The Heavy Price of an $11.1 Million Contract The financial aspect of keeping Duran is the most pressing issue for the Red Sox this winter. Talk Sox projected his 2027 salary at $11.1 million, which is a steep price for a player with his recent production. His salary history shows a rapid climb from $760,000 in 2024 to $7.7 million in 2026. This projection places a heavy burden on the team’s payroll with little guarantee of a return to form. Spending over $11 million on a player with a .207 average limits the team’s ability to sign other free agents. The Red Sox need to address their offense and pitching depth without being tied up by one underperforming player. item.title: ‘A new home for Arch next year’: Former SEC quarterback says Texas is limiting Arch Manning
item.description: Dec 21, 2024; Austin, Texas, USA; Detailed view of the jersey of Texas Longhorns quarterback Arch Manning (16) against the Clemson Tigers during the CFP National playoff first round at Darrell K Royal-Texas Memorial Stadium. Mandatory Credit: Mark J. Rebilas-Imagn Images Texas Longhorns quarterback Arch Manning has faced plenty of scrutiny this season, with his struggles cooling much of the talk about him heading to the NFL after the season. But one ESPN analyst thinks that the bigger problem might be the offense he’s playing in. On Wednesday, former quarterback Jordan Rodgers argued that Steve Sarkisian’s offense isn’t allowing Manning to develop as a quarterback, and he suggested that a transfer to a different program after the season might make more sense than the NFL Draft. Manning’s Up-and-Down Season Manning entered the season as a Heisman Trophy favorite and the early favorite to go No. 1 overall in the 2027 NFL Draft, and Texas started the year at No. 1. But the Longhorns then lost back-to-back games to Oklahoma and Florida by identical 27-24 scores, with Manning committing costly late turnovers in both. After the Florida loss, Sarkisian refused to commit to his quarterback. “Everything is going to be evaluated,” Sarkisian said. Sarkisian reportedly warned Manning that he would make a change if things didn’t improve, and Manning responded on Saturday. He threw for 212 yards and a touchdown and ran for two more scores, including the go-ahead touchdown in the fourth quarter, as No. 19 Texas upset No. 7 Ole Miss 34-27 to improve to 5-2. Still, Manning turned the ball over three times, and the win came with some more bad news , as star left tackle Trevor Goosby is reportedly out for the season with a knee injury. Manning’s struggles have also changed the conversation around his future. Some NFL executives reportedly doubt that he’ll even enter the 2027 draft, and former College GameDay analyst David Pollack recently predicted that Manning won’t be at Texas next season. ‘A New Home for Arch’ Rodgers doesn’t think Manning is getting the chance to show what he can really do. “Well Arch has got to be allowed to play quarterback, and he’s really not right now,” Rodgers said on Get Up , via On3 . “Hembo had a great stat for me. 48% of his throws are either at or behind the line of scrimmage or 20+ yards downfield. That’s by far one of the highest in the entire country. So it’s either a quick, easy layup or a bomb downfield that’s low percentage that puts him in trouble. We’ve seen some interceptions there.” Rodgers added that Manning isn’t being asked to handle many of the responsibilities NFL teams look for. “He’s not allowed to really — maybe he’s not allowed or he can’t, either way — he doesn’t change things pre-snap. This offense doesn’t allow him to slide protections, read Mike. You don’t see him doing some of that,” Rodgers said. “He also doesn’t get full-field progressions where they’re attacking the short to intermediate area of the field.”

item.title: Lakers Point to Defense After Crushing Loss to Trail Blazers
item.description: Support Local Media - Click to Add LA Sports Report as a Preferred Source on Google The Los Angeles Lakers lost their first game of the season against the Portland Trail Blazers on Tuesday, falling short in a 136-129 shootout. The Lakers’ offense clearly isn’t the issue, as they’re averaging the second most points per game in the league with 129.3, and the players know they need to improve on the defensive end. “We’ve been relying on our offense a lot,” center Walker Kessler said . “And we have a very, very good offense and a lot of great scorers. But that’s not gonna be the only thing that gets us to win a championship here.” The Lakers got off to a great start to the game, leading by as many as 11 in the first quarter, but the Blazers had a strong hold on the rest of the game. They marginally outscored the Lakers in the second and third quarters before scoring 34 to the Lakers’ 26 in the fourth. Despite their defensive struggles so far, though, the Lakers are confident in their game plan and have the capability to figure things out. “I don’t think there was any adjustment thing that was to be made,” guard Austin Reaves said . “I think it was more so us not doing what we were supposed to. Game plan discipline wasn’t great. We got to talk more on the defensive end and just be sharper in our base coverages.” Oct 27, 2026; Los Angeles, California, USA; Los Angeles Lakers guard Luka Doncic (77) reacts against the Portland Trail Blazers in the first half at Crypto.com Arena. Mandatory Credit: Kirby Lee-Imagn Images Who Performed Well for the Lakers? The Lakers knew defense would be a problem heading into the year, but their offense performed up to par against the Blazers. Luka Doncic had yet another MVP-caliber game for the Lakers, scoring 41 points in 37 minutes while also logging five rebounds and nine assists while shooting above 50% on the evening. Reaves also had a solid game, scoring 26 points for the lakers with seven assists and four rebounds of his own. He has been extremely efficient this season, shooting 63.6% from the field and 57.1% from beyond the arc through the team’s first four games of the season. Sandro Mamukelashbili, Walker Kessler and Ziaire Williams also found themselves in double-digits by the end of the night. The Lakers clearly have the offensive tools to make some noise this season, and some minor improvements in their defense could make them a championship-level team. item.title: Eder Sarabia, Espanyol's new manager
item.description: Eder Sarabia, Espanyol's new manager RCD Espanyol de Barcelona have officially appointed Eder Sarabia as their new first-team head coach, signing him to a contract that runs until June 30, 2028 . The Catalan club’s board has turned to the Biscay-born coach to take charge of the squad and get their season back on track. The change in the dugout at Cornellà-El Prat comes just 24 hours after the sacking of Manolo González. The previous coach’s time ran out abruptly following a shock Copa del Rey exit against fourth-tier Sestao River and a five-match winless run in the league that yielded just one point from a possible fifteen. At 46, Sarabia takes on this challenge following spells as head coach of FC Andorra and Elche CF, as well as serving as Quique Setién’s assistant at UD Las Palmas, Real Betis and FC Barcelona. Known for his attacking approach, playing out from the back and distinctive tactical identity, Sarabia arrives with the task of lifting the squad’s spirits and making them more consistently competitive on the pitch. Joining him on his new venture at Espanyol are coaching staff members Jon López, Jon Moreno, Aitor Unzué and a familiar face for the club’s supporters: Álvaro González. The former Cantabrian centre-back, who made 82 competitive appearances for Espanyol during his playing career, now returns to join Sarabia’s coaching staff and bring his experience to the dressing room. Eder Sarabia will be officially unveiled as Espanyol’s new head coach before the accredited media at the Juan Segura Palomares Auditorium at RCDE Stadium. Following Sergio García’s brief spell overseeing training on an interim basis, the new coaching staff will take charge immediately to prepare for the upcoming La Liga match against Villarreal, where Sarabia will begin his new chapter at the Espanyol helm. item.title: 'You deserve this more than anything' - Harry Kane's wife Kate shares emotional Instagram tribute after Ballon d'Or triumph
item.description: 70th Ballon D'Or Ceremony - Arrivals - Getty Images Entertainment Harry Kane's wife Kate has shared an emotional Instagram tribute to the England captain after he was crowned the world's best player at the Ballon d'Or ceremony in London on Monday night. Kate told her husband he deserves the award "more than anything", while the Bayern Munich striker had already used his acceptance speech to thank his childhood sweetheart and their four children. Kate Kane shares emotional tribute after Ballon d'Or win Kane was crowned the winner of the Ballon d'Or at the London Palladium on Monday night, seeing off competition from Kylian Mbappe and Lamine Yamal after scoring 73 goals for club and country last season. Kate was by his side at the ceremony and, according to the Daily Mail, the couple then celebrated into the night with friends and family at an afterparty at Cirque le Soir in Soho. Now that the dust has settled, Kate has shared a heartfelt message with her 478,000 followers on Instagram, writing: "Words can't even describe how proud I am of you. Your hard work, dedication and resilience are something I'm in awe of every single day. Every setback you've faced, you've come back stronger. I'm so glad the world gets to see your incredible talent, dedication and all the hard work you've put in to get here. You deserve this more than anything, and I couldn't be prouder to stand by your side and watch you shine. Here's to you and all that's yet to come!" Kane thanks his wife in Ballon d'Or speech Kane had already made sure to pay tribute to Kate, his childhood sweetheart, in his acceptance speech on Monday. The couple, who are both from Walthamstow, married in 2019, two years after he proposed in the Bahamas, and shared a kiss on the night after he picked up both the Ballon d'Or and the striker award. "To my wife, Kate, my best friend," Kane said. "We've been through ups and downs for sure. You're my biggest supporter. I actually felt like you wanted this more than me myself. The anxious wait for us to find out, I know it's been horrible for you, here it is - we've done it! You always want the best for me, you sacrifice yourself to help me achieve my dreams, and I know they're your dreams as well, so it wouldn't be possible without you. This is a trophy that we celebrate, not me. This is me and you, it's all the family, all our close-knit team, so I just want to say thank you, I love you. Can't wait to enjoy this and celebrate tonight for sure. Love you." Kane dedicates Ballon d'Or to his four children The couple have four children, daughters Ivy and Vivienne and sons Louis and Henry, and have settled in Bavaria since Kane joined Bayern from Tottenham. Kate, a sports science graduate and professional fitness coach, has been a constant presence by his side, and Kane also spoke directly to the children during his speech. item.title: Ramsey proud of performance in Stockport win
item.description: Aaron Ramsey was appointed as Oxford United head coach in June [Getty Images] Oxford United head coach Aaron Ramsey says his side's win over Stockport County was the performance he is "most proud" of during his time at the club. The U's edged past the Hatters at the Kassam Stadium thanks to Mark Harris' first-half strike, slotting the ball home from Siriki Dembele's low cross after 35 minutes. Oxford have now won six of their 11 matches this season, losing only once in the league, and are now up to third in the League One table. "This performance is definitely the one that has made me the most proud," Ramsey told BBC Radio Oxford. "I can't fault the boys for our out of possession work and we showed a lot more courage with the ball to show that we can play through teams. "Everybody played their part and we're going to need them all throughout the whole season." Since their only league defeat - away at Huddersfield - Oxford have won five and drawn three, and are still undefeated at home in all competitions. Oxford have played less games than the teams around them because of postponements in the previous international break, a situation set to be repeated later this month because of call-ups for Oxford players. "It's taken a while to make up some ground because of the games we have had postponed," Ramsey added. "It was nice to play one of those games where we had the chance to jump up a few places and it was important to take full advantage of that. "The boys executed the game plan superbly and the fans also helped us to get over the line in the end. "I hope the fans can be proud too, I want them to enjoy the football that they come here to see, I want this to be an environment that we can all really enjoy." item.title: Real Madrid, La Liga apology over Mbappe shows power of Chinese market
item.description: Real Madrid players, pictured on a tour of China in 2011. The country is highly lucrative for the Spanish giants (MARK RALSTON) Faced with a widespread boycott in China following the controversy sparked by Kylian Mbappe's comments about Mao Zedong, Real Madrid added its own apology on Tuesday. The move was widely viewed as a move by the Spanish giants and 15-time European champions to protect their commercial interests in China. The furore was unleashed after a short video clip showed a meme depicting Mbappe as Mao Zedong, whom he calls a "Chinese dictator." Three sponsors have dropped Mbappe and Chinese state TV has suspended the broadcast of Spanish league matches, jeopardizing La Liga's international development strategy. - Key market for La Liga - The apologies from La Liga and its president, Javier Tebas, as well as by Mbappe and Real Madrid, have so far failed to calm the situation. They have though served to highlight the crucial importance of the Chinese market for Spanish football. A source within La Liga told AFP that China and the United States alone finance the "majority" of the international broadcasting rights, which were valued at 748 million euros ($834 million) for the 2024-25 season. According to La Liga, the matches broadcast on state-run CCTV are among the most-watched sporting events in the country. Since 2016, La Liga has even adapted its schedule to Asian time zones, which has allowed it to significantly increase its viewership and, consequently, the value of its international TV rights. On August 3, La Liga announced a new agreement with digital giant Migu, a subsidiary of China Mobile, to broadcast 380 matches a season until 2030, saying it confirmed "the league's long-term commitment to developing its fan base in China". - Jerseys and sponsors - In addition to these global contracts, the two giants of Spanish football, Real Madrid and Barcelona, each have multi-million-euro investments in China. According to the Real Madrid-affiliated newspaper Marca, the Madrid club generates between 10 and 15 percent of its sales of jerseys and merchandise in China. Real Madrid also counts Chinese companies among its main sponsors with Hisense, sports betting firm Kaiyun Sports and Linglong Tire all featuring prominently. Real Madrid's veteran president Florentino Perez, who made his fortune in construction through his publicly traded ACS group, owns several subsidiaries in China and Hong Kong. As part of a development agreement between La Liga and Chinese sports institutions, Real Madrid and Barcelona have played several pre-season friendlies in Asia against Chinese, Japanese, and South Korean teams in recent years. Smith has been ruled out of the enthralling decisive Test against South Africa with a neck injury. Without him, Australia wanted their number three to feast at last chance saloon, where he has been perched for an eternity, on day two in Cape Town. The 32-year-old lasted five deliveries and did not score a run. Labuschagne failed to scored a Test century for the 48th time in a row - a new record for the number of innings an Australian top order batter has waited to raise his bat at three figures. "That will never be broken," said former Australia quick Jason Gillespie on ABC. "I say that because, respectfully, I don't think anyone will be given that length of time again." There was a time when, from his insertion into the 2019 Ashes as a concussion substitute until the end of England's next quest to win back the urn, Labuschagne averaged 65 in Test cricket. Repeat that over a Test career and only Sir Donald Bradman's mark of 99.94 would be ahead. Instead, since his last Test century at Old Trafford in 2023, he averages 24.77.
